lines.text: A few days later...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Whoa!

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Is this your new place? It looks nice!

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: *Cough, cough* Yeah, it's great.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Where's Princess?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Huh? Isn't she at work?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: What are you talking about? Today's our day off.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: That's why I came by to hang out.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Then where'd she go? She took off first thing after waking up.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: You know, she's been sneaking off to this one place by herself lately.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: She just stands there for a while, then comes back. You know anything about it?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Hmm... No.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Over where she's been going,

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: there's this crawlspace that connects to the Ark.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Didn't she keep saying she wanted to go back to the Ark?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Maybe she's going there?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: I mean, they call it a crawlspace, but really it's just a passage you can bribe your way through.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: But I doubt Big Madam would let her do that.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: ... Think she's trying to escape?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: No way...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Right? There's no way. She's been around the Outer Rim long enough. She wouldn't be that stupid.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Unless she's looking to get herself killed...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Let's go check it out. I've got a bad feeling about this.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Me too. Lead the way.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Found her. She's over there.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: But I can't see too well. We've gotta get closer.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: What are you gonna do if we get caught?

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: How do you think I got my name? Sneaking around like an alley rat is in my nature.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Your cough... Can you hold it in?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Hold my hand.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Huh? Wh-why are you suddenly asking me to?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: My eyesight's gotten really bad.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: You said you were fine lately.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Heheh...

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: ... Here. Grab my hand. Let's go.
Stall III and Free Rat move cautiously while holding hands.
Hiding near a pile of scrap, they spot Princess standing no more than twenty paces away.
Princess taps her foot anxiously.
After a short while,
a priestess clad in white and gold emerges from a small opening in the partition.
Her face is veiled, but she seems visibly shocked the moment she sees Princess.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Your Holiness!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You...!
*Whack!*
Princess kicks the priestess in the leg.
The priestess staggers for a moment, then regains her footing.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Your Holiness...! You're truly alive...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Three years...! For three years, you left me rotting in this place without a single message! What exactly were you doing?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Explain yourself!
Princess's necklace shimmers with a golden light.
The priestess recoils in fear.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Please... Please allow me to explain everything! I beg you, temper your anger...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Speak! Now!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Okay...!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: That day, the day of your corporeal transference...

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: While you were resting after the ritual had concluded,

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: a man suddenly appeared.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: V.T.C. was annihilated, quite literally, by that single intruder.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Once the transference ritual was over, you withdrew to rest, while the remaining members enjoyed the celebrations.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: That man entered the hall quietly.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: He wore a commander's uniform, held a pistol in one hand, and carried a large backpack.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: He stood there staring at us,

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: and then... he attacked.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Neither the deployed Nikkes nor the robots were of any use.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: We were slaughtered, powerless to do anything.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: ... By one person? What kind of disgusting joke is this?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: He was... a monster disguised as a human.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I still can't wrap my head around how he did it,

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: how he killed everyone.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Only a handful survived, including myself.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Like I said, what kind of disgusting joke is this?!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Trust me!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I do not wish to believe it either, and yet it is the truth!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: He single-handedly killed more than two hundred people!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Who? Who was it?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: It was... Andersen.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Andersen...! Commander of the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: How...?! He was supposed to be in a coma!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Did you get revenge?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: We... could not.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: The senior officers who were involved in the transference ritual all perished, and V.T.C.'s chain of command collapsed.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: The Central Government then elevated that man to the position of deputy chief, placing him entirely beyond our reach.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Damn those Central Government dogs! All that time circling me, and now they finally bare their fangs...!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: The moment V.T.C.'s power waned, the Central Government descended upon us with unrestrained fury.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: It was... a purge.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Very few devotees remain within the Ark.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: How many?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: More or less... two percent.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I... I persuaded and rallied the remaining devotees, Your Holiness.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I never expected it would take three years, but I did everything I could.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Given all that, why did you not come back for me?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Answer me!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You dumped me in the Outer Rim while I was unconscious!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I spent three years crawling through this sewer!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Why was I not contacted even once?!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: W-we had no funds...

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Entering the Outer Rim safely requires an enormous bribe, money we simply did not have.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What did you say...?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: The sum we paid to the madam of Ephialtes when we entrusted you to her care... it was everything V.T.C. possessed at the time.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I barely managed to scrape together enough money just to get here today...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You really expect me to believe all this?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: That V.T.C.,

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: the rulers of the Ark—of mankind!—

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: couldn't even afford a single bribe?!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Tell me the truth. What's the real reason?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Everything I said was the truth...

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Forgive me, Your Holiness.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Ah...
Princess sinks to the floor.
She looks up at the sobbing priestess with a blank expression.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You really expect me to believe such a terrible joke...?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: *Sob* I'm sorry! I'm sorry...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Grr...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: You idiots! Just how unbelievably stupid did you have to be to let things end up like this?!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Morons! Incompetent swine! Utter dimwits, the whole lot of you!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Your Holiness... Please calm down...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Shut up! You shut your mouth, you useless simpleton! Everything I built up had been solid, and you let it all crumble in an instant...!

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: B-but you're still alive, Your Holiness.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: So long as you're alive, there's still hope.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: When your message reached me, I was shocked beyond measure.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: To be honest... I believed you had already passed.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: You were in the Outer Rim, after all.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Even though we paid the madam, I assumed that the creatures of this refuse heap would never honor such an agreement.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: There was nowhere safe for us to hide at the time, so we made the only choice we could, knowing full well it could end badly.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Y-yet here you stand, alive.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: And since you're alive, we can regroup. We can rebuild V.T.C.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Our devotees in the Ark have lost not just their wealth, but their symbol.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: All they've witnessed is our one-sided purge at the hands of the Central Government.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: But if you show them that you still stand strong, they will rally once more.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: How?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Do you still have... the key?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: As if abandoning me wasn't enough, now you dare question my authority?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Not at all. I merely wondered...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I have it. It's still in one piece.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Oh...! Then...!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: What exactly do you think you're going to do with it?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: So long as we have the key and all the dormant ancient technology contained within,

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: V.T.C. can rise again at any time.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: The pact prevented us from using the key's power, but as things stand, there is no longer any reason to uphold it.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Once we demonstrate technology generations ahead of its time, all of those foolish humans will again fall under our thumb.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: It will certainly take time.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: But time is of no consequence to us.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: If we endure a brief humiliation, and work in the shadows...

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: we can reclaim dominion over humanity.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: Do you have it on your person now...?

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Do you really believe I'd walk around carrying something that important?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: But your body was the only thing transported to the Outer Rim...

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: So?
The priestess's gaze travels over Princess, stopping at the necklace.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Tell me, do you really think having the key alone will make you fit for the title of Her Holiness?

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: I... I would never...! Don't be ridiculous.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: I'll consider your proposal.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: There is nothing to consider! We must act immediately!

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Remember very clearly whose presence you're in when you voice your insignificant opinions.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: ...! My deepest apologies, Your Holiness.

lines.speaker: princess
lines.text: Await further instructions.

lines.speaker: priestess
lines.text: As you command...
Princess turns sharply and walks away.
After watching her for a long moment, the priestess heads back toward the partition.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: What the...? What was that about...?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Free Rat.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Uh-huh? What is it?

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: First of all, don't tell anyone what you saw and heard today.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: I didn't even understand a single thing they said.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Still, not a word to anyone. Especially not to Big Madam.

lines.speaker: freerat
lines.text: Fine. My lips are sealed.

lines.speaker: stall3rd
lines.text: Good, thanks.
